manuscript_status: AI-assisted, unrefereed; independently audited as scoped partial results with the Section 5 wording correction. Not formally verified.
accepted_by_author: Explicit faithful disk-boundary action for every countable left-orderable group, hence a faithful action on every nonempty surface.
A credited finitely generated torsion-free non-left-orderable group acts on every surface, using Hyde and periodic disk rigidity.
The level-three congruence subgroup of SL(4,Z) is infinite, finitely generated and torsion-free; BFH gives nonfaithfulness of every C2 closed-surface action.
An iterated semidirect-product proof shows Le Roux G2 is left-orderable and acts faithfully on every surface despite its free-planar-action obstruction.
A faithful locally moving torsion-free surface action forces a subgroup Z^n for every n.
remaining: A finitely generated torsion-free witness excluded from every faithful C0 action on a prescribed closed surface.
Alternatively, a universal faithful-action construction for arbitrary finitely generated torsion-free groups.
For the explicit congruence-lattice candidate, removal of C2 regularity without importing freeness or local-moving hypotheses.
mathematical_corrections: Local moving and existence of a dense global orbit are incomparable; the definition explicitly concerns a nonidentity induced homeomorphism.
